added.title: Maximo Product Manager - Functional Senior Consultant
added.description:
Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. We offer comprehensive end-to-end support and advisory services, covering areas such as valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. The team works closely with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and implement practical solutions before, during, and after major transformational projects or transactions creating lasting impact.

Are you passionate about helping clients design, build and deploy solutions which transform their organization and their asset management function? As trusted advisors to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and other key executives, we advise, implement, and deliver as-a-service solutions that enhance asset management capabilities. Join our team of Maximo and asset management technology professionals, where industry expertise, innovation, technical skills and specialized knowledge come together to empower clients to amplify the value of their technology investments.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/06/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant you will:

Own the Maximo product strategy for a large-scale, multi-year IBM Maximo / IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) program, including scope, value cases, roadmap, and release planning across modules
Partner with business and operations leaders to define and operationalize success measures and KPIs (e.g., schedule compliance, backlog health, preventive maintenance completion, wrench time, mean time to repair/mean time between failures where applicable)
Lead end-to-end process design and continuous improvement across the work lifecycle (request intake, triage, approval, planning, scheduling, execution, completion, and closeout), ensuring operational feasibility and compliance
Translate operational needs into Maximo capabilities, including configuration requirements, automation opportunities, integration needs, and data standards; maintain clear functional direction through delivery and sustainment
Own and manage the product backlog, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and release readiness; coordinate dependencies across business, IT, and delivery teams
Facilitate workshops and ceremonies (discovery, design, prioritization, refinement) and actively participate/support agile delivery events (e.g., sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives)
Drive SIT/UAT readiness and execution, partnering with technical teams and business testers to validate solutions, resolve defects, and confirm business outcomes
Incorporate mobile execution considerations (technician experience, offline/online needs, usability) into process and solution design to improve adoption and productivity
Lead enablement, training, and adoption, including developing training materials and delivering end-user and administrator trainings; support change efforts to drive sustained usage
Strengthen data quality and reporting by defining data standards, supporting governance, and enabling dashboards/insights to inform operational decisions and continuous improvement
Communicate effectively at all levels, from frontline users to executive stakeholders, producing high-quality artifacts (process flows, decision logs, status, and presentations) that drive alignment and decisions

A successful candidate would possesses these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Infrastructure and Real Estate team are trusted advisors to clients in managing physical assets throughout their lifecycle. We help them unlock value from their asset and real estate portfolios and functions by developing strategies, optimizing operating models and organizational design, and leveraging technology enablement.

Qualifications Required

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university
6+ years of experience with IBM Maximo and/or IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) in enterprise environments
Demonstrated depth across asset management, work management, inventory/storeroom, and procurement processes and Maximo configuration
Proven experience serving as a Product Manager / Product Owner / Functional Lead for Maximo implementations and/or large run/operate programs
Strong client-facing consulting experience, including requirements facilitation, stakeholder alignment, and executive communication
Experience developing and delivering training (end-user and admin) and creating enablement content for diverse audiences
Strong documentation skills (e.g., process flows, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and presentations)
Familiarity with agile delivery methods, tools, and release management practices (e.g., Jira / Azure DevOps)
Experience using artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools and digital technologies to improve efficiency, support analysis, and enhance the quality of work products
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

IBM Maximo/MAS certification
Agile certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master, SAFe)
Experience with Maximo capabilities including Preventive Maintenance (PM), Planning & Scheduling, Assets/Locations, Purchasing, Inventory/Storeroom, mobile solutions, and reporting/analytics
Knowledge of MAS concepts (where relevant), such as authentication/roles, environment management, and upgrade considerations
Experience in regulated or asset-intensive industries (e.g., utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, transportation, public sector)
Demonstrated strengths in: communication and influence, facilitation, pragmatic value-based prioritization, change leadership, structured execution, and relationship-building

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 - $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various fac tors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Product Management and Marketing

Industries

Accounting, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Business Consulting and Services
